svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.41k stars in total, about 1.84k a year earlier. jactionlint 336, mr boxington 763, aube 2072, fnox 2386, hk 1318, pitchfork 716, usage 1077, +6 more 738.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
